newsitem.title: USA: Tower Dec block hours fall, load factor up.
newsitem.headline: Tower Dec block hours fall, load factor up.

text.p: Tower Air Inc said on Tuesday that its total block hours fell 30.3 percent in December to 2,475 hours from 3,550 hours in December 1995 from reductions in international scheduled service and the withdrawal from the India market.

December's passenger load factor increased to 77.8 percent compared to 71.0 percent in December 1995, Tower said. The increased load factor was from improvements in the Tel Aviv, Paris, San Juan and Brazil markets, Tower said.
Tower Air said 1996's total block hours flown decreased 12.4 percent to 41,336 hours from 47,186 hours in 1995.
Tower Air's 1996 passenger service load factor for the year fell 2.7 points to 72.0 percent from 74.7 percent in 1995, the carrier said.
